title: Sign in to hocX

status.totpSetupStartFailed: TOTP setup could not be started

mfa.requiredTitle: MFA is required for this account
mfa.requiredGenericDescription: {user} needs a second factor before logging in.
mfa.methodTotpDescription: Authenticator app on phone or desktop
mfa.methodPasskeyDescriptionAvailable: Face ID, Touch ID or Windows Hello
mfa.methodPasskeyDescriptionUnavailable: Not available in this browser or on this domain
mfa.passkeySetupDescription: Your device will now open the native security dialog. You'll be logged in right after confirming.
mfa.setupPasskeyAndLogin: Set up passkey and log in
mfa.chooseMethodSubtitle: Choose how you want to confirm your identity.
mfa.passkeyChoiceAvailable: With Face ID, fingerprint or device PIN
mfa.codeChoiceDescription: Enter the code from your authenticator app
mfa.confirmCodeSubtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.confirmPasskeySubtitle: Follow your device's prompts to sign in with Face ID, fingerprint or device PIN.
mfa.lostFactorHint: Lost your second factor? An administrator of your organization can reset it under «Logins & roles».
mfa.requiredTenantDescription: {user} is signing in to {tenant}. The organisation requires a second factor for every login.
mfa.setupRequiredRedirect: Your organisation requires MFA. Sign in again and set up a second factor.
mfa.graceDescription: You can skip the setup until {until} – after that you can only sign in with a second factor.

releaseLinkTitle: Open release and changelog on GitHub (new tab)

bridge.title: Continue sign-in
bridge.question: Sign in as {name} ({email}) at {tenant}?
bridge.hint: Only continue if you started this sign-in yourself and this is your account.
bridge.invalid: This sign-in link is invalid or has expired. Please sign in again.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot password
forgotPassword.intro: Enter your account's email address. We'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgotPassword.sent: If an account with this address exists, a link is on its way. It is valid for 60 minutes. Please also check your spam folder.
forgotPassword.failed: The request could not be sent.

setPassword.inviteIntro: Hello {name}, {tenant} has invited you to hocX. First, set a password.
setPassword.resetDone: Your password has been changed. All previous sessions have been ended.
setPassword.inviteDone: Your account is set up. You can sign in now.
setPassword.mfaHint: If you have set up a second factor, hocX will still ask for it when you sign in.
setPassword.invalid: This link is invalid, has expired or has already been used.
setPassword.failed: The password could not be saved.
setPassword.inviteInvalid: This invitation has expired, was withdrawn or has already been used. Please ask your organization for a new invitation.
setPassword.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and then reload the page.
setPassword.nextFactorHint: Next, you set up a second factor.
setPassword.passwordWeak: The password is too weak. Use at least 12 characters without your name, email or common words.
setPassword.flowExpired: The time for the setup has expired. Your password is saved: sign in and hocX will guide you from there.

checks.notGuessable: No name, no email, no common word

hints.guessable: Contains your name, email, a common word or repetitions. That is easy to guess.
hints.tooWeak: Still too weak. Make it longer or mix in numbers and special characters.
hints.medium: Tip: several random words are easy to remember and hard to guess.

factor.title: Set up a second factor
factor.intro: In addition to your password, you confirm the sign-in with your device. That keeps your account protected even if someone knows your password.
factor.requiredDetail: Signing in is not possible without a second factor.
factor.passkeyAvailable: With Face ID, fingerprint or device code
factor.totpDescription: 6-digit code from an app on your phone
factor.abortHint: If you stop here, hocX will ask again at your next sign-in.

totp.title: Set up authenticator app
totp.qrHint: Scan the code with an authenticator app on your phone, e.g. Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password.
totp.openInAppHint: Is the app on this phone? Then open it directly, without a QR code.

passkey.title: Set up passkey
passkey.description: Your device will open its security dialog. Confirm with Face ID, fingerprint, Windows Hello or your phone. Then you are signed in right away.
passkey.submit: Set up passkey and sign in

skip.title: Continue without a second factor?
skip.message: Your account is then protected by the password only. You can set up the second factor at any time under Profile › Security.

done.title: All set
done.recommendLater: Recommended: set up the second factor soon under Profile › Security.
